title: Word Game
tagline: Learn English words by playing. Your words, your pace.
description: Word Game is a fast arcade-style vocabulary game: a question appears at the top and three words drift across the screen, so tap the right one before it leaves. Look any word up in a built-in dictionary and thesaurus that works offline, practise analogies, keep word lists for test prep or fun, and pick an age group and a learning level so the words fit you. Words you miss come back for spaced review. Your progress stays on your phone.
howToPlay: Tap Play for a quick session, or choose an Age group and Learning level in Settings, or open Words & pace to pick words, topics and speed.
Try the Journey: a campaign from letters and first words up to graduate vocabulary, with stars, checkpoints and a placement check.
A question appears at the top; three words drift in from the right. Tap the right one before it leaves on the left.
Questions include synonyms, antonyms, meanings, spelling, listening and analogies such as hot : cold :: big : ?
Tap any word to open the dictionary and thesaurus: meanings, sound, synonyms and opposites by closeness, all offline.
Keep word lists for test prep, practice or fun; Study makes a set of words with flashcards, then quizzes you on just those.
Review brings back the words that are due, so what you miss comes back sooner and what you know comes back later.
Tap Watch & Learn for a free demo that plays itself and pauses before every answer so you can guess first.
